# Test photographs

Development/test fixtures only; they are not served by the application and are
not used to train anything.

| File | Source | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `car-1.jpg` | `danielgatis/rembg` repository, `examples/car-1.jpg` (MIT-licensed repository) | primary real-inference proof and TEST-AC-12 |
| `car-2.jpg` | `danielgatis/rembg` repository, `examples/car-2.jpg` | second object category/background |
| `animal-2.jpg` | `danielgatis/rembg` repository, `examples/animal-2.jpg` | different object category |
| `plants-1.jpg` | `danielgatis/rembg` repository, `examples/plants-1.jpg` | complex background/scale |

The rembg repository is MIT licensed. The example photographs are included
there for demonstration; keep this attribution if the fixtures are reused.
